messages:
Mara (UX): Putting up a quick prototype of the preview card for schema-driven tool calls in the playground. Want feedback on layout, copy, and a11y notes. Screenshot attached (mock). :eyes:

dimitar: Nice! Quick thought — collapse by default for large schemas? The preview gets noisy for >6 props.

sam (frontend): Agree collapse by default. Also we need a clear affordance for 'expand sample output' — maybe a chevron + "Preview sample" label.

cory: Copy nit: "Sample output" vs "Example response" — which aligns with run history? I'd prefer "Example response".

jess (PM): Also show estimated token cost on the card header. Helps users set expectations. small gray text.

Mara (UX): Good call on token cost. Proposed header: function name | model token est | run-count badge. Layout idea: left name, center small description, right badges (token/run).

sam (frontend): Implementation note: keep badge contrast >= 4.5:1. Current purple on white fails for small text. Use bold text or an outline.

dimitar: Keyboard nav: ensure the preview card is reachable with tab and that expand/collapse is Space/Enter actionable. Add role="button" and aria-expanded attributes.

Mara (UX): For screen readers, announce when sample output finishes streaming. Use an aria-live="polite" region that says "Sample output loaded".

cory: Also add a small "view raw" toggle that reveals the JSON payload. People often want to copy raw response.

sam (frontend): Suggestion: keep a 1-line collapsed JSON summary like `{ id: 123, status: "ok", ... }` with a copy icon. Full raw opens in a modal.

Mara (UX): Copy phrasing proposal for the action button: "Insert into prompt" vs "Use in prompt" — thoughts?

jess (PM): Strong +1 for "Insert into prompt" — clearer and action-oriented.

accessibility-bot: Automated check: color contrast warning on run-count badge. Recommend #1f2a44 for 14px bold on white.

dimitar: Tiny palette nit: status chips (required/optional) should be distinguishable without color (icon + text). Maybe use a dashed underline or an asterisk for required.

Mara (UX): I'll update the mock with these changes. One last question: should run history entries deep link back to the exact invocation instance (open inspector anchored to that invocation)?

cory: Yes—deep links please. Clicking a run history item should open the inspector and scroll to that invocation.

Mara (UX): Thanks all — I'll push an updated Figma and share when ready. :thumbsup:

sam (frontend): FYI I'll prototype the expand animation and aria attributes next sprint.

jess (PM): Leaving a small doc ticket: DOCS-241 to add copy snippets and tooltip text.

Mara (UX): Done — filing it now.
